verdict.rationale: OCI documents a platform-wide CLI that 'provides the same core functionality as the Console,' typical REST APIs across services, and SDKs that ship with documentation. Together these suggest broad, uniform programmatic coverage, but no evidence shows per-service API/CLI reference pages existing consistently for every service. Machine-readable OpenAPI specs were not found at the probed docs-root paths. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service API and CLI reference docs across the whole catalog (not just flagship services), proof the reference format is consistent between services, discoverable OpenAPI/spec artifacts, and independent corroboration of reference completeness.

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: The CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure APIs are typical REST APIs that use HTTPS requests and responses.
Each SDK provides the tools you need to develop an app, including code samples and documentation to create, test, and troubleshoot.
